description: This line plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of three different models—labeled "Squared Exponential," "Tanh," and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B"—as a function of the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 1500 along the x-axis, which is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from approximately 45 to 55 and also uses a linear scale. The "Squared Exponential" model is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 53.5 at 0 demonstrations and rising to a peak of 56 at around 250 demonstrations before leveling off near 56 across the full range. The "Tanh" model is shown as a dashed dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 48.5 and remaining relatively stable near 48.5 throughout the demonstration range. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model is depicted as a dotted pink line with circular markers, consistently hovering near 47.5 across all demonstrated values. A horizontal dashed pink line at approximately 47.5 serves as a reference baseline for the LLaMA model’s performance.
